plot: In the pantry in the late afternoon Toastmaw locks Bup and Lolly in and counts down 60 seconds before firing 40 slices; Bup's distraction fails, Zeek reveals old toasters fire straight up, Lolly's terrifying 'please' makes Toastmaw aim at the shelf, the toast becomes a staircase to the window, and from the top they see an army of appliances marching on the garden.

beats.say: SIXTY SECONDS! Then this whole pantry becomes TOAST!
Lolly, the door! Pull! Pull harder!
It's locked from the outside! Who locks a pantry from the OUTSIDE?!
Late afternoon. Bup and Lolly came in for one jar of honey. Now they are locked in with a very angry toaster.
Mr. Pot gave me a timer. When it rings, I fire every slice I have. Forty slices. Extra crispy.
Forty?! You can't even FIT forty slices in there!
I am much bigger on the inside. Fifty seconds!
Okay, Bup. You always have a plan. A loud, clumsy, wonderful plan. What's the plan?
Give me one second. Thinking. Thinking very hard. My crust is sweating.
The plan is... I distract him. You find a light switch. Go!
Hey, toaster! Your crumb tray is dirty! Disgusting! Ewww!
My crumb tray is SPOTLESS! I clean it every single Sunday!
Switch, switch... jars, jars, flour, one very old potato... no switch!
Bup? Lolly? We can hear ticking! Is that a bomb? Is it a clock? Is it my heart?
Pim, please. It's a kitchen timer. Very old toaster model. Those always fire their toast straight up.
Straight up? Like popcorn? I hate popcorn. It jumps at you without asking!
Straight... up...
Lolly, why are you smiling? Why is she smiling? That's the scary smile.
Look up, Bup. The tiny window. Above the top shelf.
It's way too high. We'd need a ladder. A tall one. With handrails.
Or forty slices of toast. Stacked.
Mister Toastmaw, could you please, pretty please, aim at the shelf?
Why would I do anything for a polite little cookie?
BECAUSE I SAID PLEASE AND I DO NOT SAY IT TWICE!
Yes ma'am! Aiming at the shelf, ma'am! Right away, ma'am!
Forty golden slices fly up, land on the shelves, and click together into a perfect crunchy staircase.
It's warm. My feet are warm. This is the nicest escape of my whole life.
Toast stairs. Bold. Crunchy. I approve.
Crispy?! How long have you been in here?!
I am always in here. The old potato and I are friends.
Climb, boys. Quickly. Sweetly. NOW.
Wait. I'm empty. If Mr. Pot finds out I wasted every slice...
Then tell him a star cookie said please. He'll understand. Probably.
Nobody... has ever said please to me before.
Then get used to it, mister. Next time you want a friend, try please before fire.
At the top of the toast staircase, the tiny window creaks open onto the garden.
We made it! Home in two minutes. Honey in one hand, victory in the other.
Bup. We forgot the honey. And look down at the garden.
Why is the garden... moving? Gardens are not supposed to move. That's the one rule of gardens.
Kettles. Blenders. A waffle iron. All of them marching toward the stove.
Did anyone else just hear a waffle iron LAUGH?!

long.title: 60 Seconds Before the Toaster Fires 🔥
long.description: Bup and Lolly came in for one jar of honey, and now Toastmaw has locked them in the pantry with a timer: when it rings, 40 slices fly. Bup's plan fails... but Lolly is wearing the scary smile. How would YOU have escaped? 👇 #animation #doughbros #horrorcomedy
